p.src: 1  Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.

en: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.
u.src: 1  Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.

en:
112:1 Hebrew: יה Yah. Psalm 112 is an acrostic poem, with each verse after the initial “Praise the LORD!” starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav).
112:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

en: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
u.src: 2  His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

p.src: 3  Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

en: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
u.src: 3  Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

p.src: 4  Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

en: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
u.src: 4  Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

p.src: 5  It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

en: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
u.src: 5  It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

p.src: 6  For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

en: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
u.src: 6  For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

p.src: 7  He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

en: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
u.src: 7  He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

p.src: 8  His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

en: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
u.src: 8  His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

p.src: 9  He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

en: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
u.src: 9  He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

p.src: 10  The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

en: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
u.src: 10  The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
